A data row with more cells than the header widens the separator so no cell is silently dropped

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert

def main() -> None:
    html = "<table><tr><th>A</th><th>B</th></tr><tr><td>1</td><td>2</td><td>3</td></tr></table>"
    result = convert(html)
    print(result)

main()
```
